def transform(grid):
    sep=next(i for i,v in enumerate(grid[0]) if v==1)
    left=[row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right=[row[sep+1:] for row in grid]
    return [[2 if a or b else 0 for a,b in zip(l,r)] for l,r in zip(left,right)]
